categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai V-Test Semiconductor Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the integrated circuit (IC) testing industry, offering wafer testing (Chip Probing) and final chip testing (Final Test) services. The company also provides related support services such as testing equipment leasing and sales of testing consumables. Their testing covers a wide range of chip types including CPU, GPU, MCU, FPGA, SoC, AI chips, RF chips, memory chips, sensor chips, and power chips, serving industries like communications, computing, automotive electronics, industrial control, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary IC testing technologies and advanced testing equipment platforms such as Advantest V93000, Teradyne J750, and Chroma. It has developed complex SoC testing solutions and breakthroughs in testing high-end chips including 5G RF chips, high-performance CPUs, FPGA, and automotive-grade chips. Production is highly automated with a self-developed production management system that enhances efficiency, accuracy, and data security. The company also focuses on R&D in high-computing power chips, advanced packaging chips (Chiplet, SiP), and high-reliability automotive and industrial chips.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 200 customers including IC design companies, wafer manufacturers, packaging companies, and IDM enterprises. Key customers include well-known domestic and international chip makers such as Unisoc, ZTE Microelectronics, Fudan Microelectronics, Bitmain, and SMIC. The end markets span strategic emerging industries like AI, cloud computing, IoT, 5G, high-end equipment, new energy vehicles, and autonomous driving.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with testing bases in Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuxi, Shenzhen, and Tianjin. Its sales and customer base are concentrated in the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta regions, extending north to Northeast China. The company also has some overseas sales but the majority of revenue is domestic.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai V-Test operates as an independent third-party IC testing service provider, positioned downstream in the semiconductor supply chain. It provides testing services after chip design and wafer fabrication, before chips are integrated into final products. It is not involved in chip design or manufacturing but focuses on testing and quality assurance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding high-end chip testing and high-reliability chip testing capacity, targeting high-computing power chips (CPU, GPU, AI, FPGA), advanced architecture and packaging chips (SoC, Chiplet, SiP), and automotive/industrial-grade chips. It emphasizes continuous R&D investment, talent acquisition, and innovation in testing technologies and automation. The company also aims to enhance market penetration and customer service quality to become a leading domestic and world-class IC testing service provider.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of IC testing services, including wafer testing and final chip testing. The company also earns income from leasing testing equipment and selling testing consumables. Pricing is negotiated per customer based on test platform configuration and required labor hours, with long-term framework agreements established with major customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading independent third-party IC testing enterprises in mainland China but still smaller compared to global leaders like King Yuan Electronics, Siliconware Precision, and others. It competes with both independent third-party testers and integrated packaging and testing companies. Its competitive advantages lie in high-end testing capabilities, automation, and strong R&D, positioning it as a prominent domestic player with growth potential.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.08 billion, a 46.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 128.23 million, up 8.67%. Total assets grew 36.33% to RMB 4.92 billion, and net assets increased 6.52% to RMB 2.62 billion. The company continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, supporting a strong growth trajectory in a recovering semiconductor market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai V-Test emphasizes its advanced testing technology, comprehensive testing solutions covering a broad chip spectrum, and high production automation to deliver high-quality, efficient, and reliable testing services. Its focus on high-end and high-reliability chip testing differentiates it from competitors, enabling domestic substitution of imported testing services. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive customer base, and strategic geographic locations close to major semiconductor clusters enhance its value proposition.
